vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: Referrer-Policy
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the Referrer-Policy header to all responses.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: Permissions-Policy
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the Permissions-Policy header to all responses.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: X-Frame-Options
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the X-Frame-Options header to all responses.

vulnerabilities.name: Server Information Disclosure
vulnerabilities.remediation: Remove or obfuscate the Server header.

vulnerabilities.name: CORS Misconfiguration: Wildcard Origin
vulnerabilities.description: The server allows requests from any origin.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Restrict allowed origins to trusted domains.
